yellow_tripdataraw

One row per completed yellow taxi trip, published monthly as Parquet.

Source
nyc_tlc
Owner
mobility-data
Load
append
Refreshed
nightly: every day at 06:00 UTC
dbt
stg_nyc_tlc__yellow_tripdata
ColumnTypeAboutComes fromUsed by
VendorIDintegerTPEP provider that supplied the record. internal
Values: 1, 2, 6, 7
tpep_pickup_datetimetimestampDate and time the meter was engaged (local New York time). not null internal
tpep_dropoff_datetimetimestampDate and time the meter was disengaged (local New York time). not null internal
passenger_countintegerNumber of passengers, entered by the driver. internal
trip_distancedecimal(10,2) (miles)Elapsed trip distance reported by the taximeter. internal
RatecodeIDintegerFinal rate code in effect at the end of the trip. internal
Values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 99
store_and_fwd_flagstringY if the record was held in vehicle memory before sending because the vehicle had no server connection. internal
Values: N, Y
PULocationIDintegerTLC taxi zone where the meter was engaged. internal
DOLocationIDintegerTLC taxi zone where the meter was disengaged. internal
payment_typeintegerHow the passenger paid for the trip. internal
Values: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
fare_amountdecimal(10,2) (USD)Time-and-distance fare calculated by the meter. confidential
extradecimal(10,2) (USD)Miscellaneous extras and surcharges, such as rush-hour and overnight charges. confidential
mta_taxdecimal(10,2) (USD)MTA tax triggered automatically by the metered rate in use. confidential
tip_amountdecimal(10,2) (USD)Tip amount; populated for credit card tips only, cash tips are not recorded. confidential
tolls_amountdecimal(10,2) (USD)Total tolls paid during the trip. confidential
improvement_surchargedecimal(10,2) (USD)Improvement surcharge assessed at flag drop. confidential
total_amountdecimal(10,2) (USD)Total amount charged to passengers; excludes cash tips. confidential
congestion_surchargedecimal(10,2) (USD)New York State congestion surcharge collected for the trip. confidential
Airport_feedecimal(10,2) (USD)Fee for pickups at LaGuardia and JFK airports. confidential

  • yellow_tripdata → taxi_zone_lookup: many_to_one, yellow_tripdata.PULocationID = taxi_zone_lookup.LocationID
  • yellow_tripdata → taxi_zone_lookup: many_to_one, yellow_tripdata.DOLocationID = taxi_zone_lookup.LocationID
